title: Reconcile dependency drift exposed by the frozen install
change: If it fails, run `pnpm install --lockfile-only`, commit the lockfile, and record every version that moved in tasks/DRIFT-REPORT.md.
Re-run typecheck and tests. Fix ONLY breakages caused by the version moves.
exit: cd frontend && pnpm run typecheck  →  exit 0
cd frontend && pnpm run test:ci  →  exit 0
forbidden: Do NOT change source files to make tests pass. If a test fails, the dependency move is the cause — record it.
escalate: A dependency requires a MAJOR version change to resolve. Stop; that is a human decision.
